entries.name: Barbarian
entries.description: A fierce warrior who channels primal Rage: damage resistance, raw strength, and devastating strikes.

features.name: Rage
features.description: As a Bonus Action (not in Heavy armor) you enter a Rage; uses are in the Rages column (regain one on a Short Rest, all on a Long Rest). While raging: Resistance to Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing damage; a bonus to damage with Strength-based attacks (Rage Damage column); Advantage on Strength checks and saves; no Concentration or spells. It lasts until the end of your next turn and extends if you attack, force a save, or use a Bonus Action (up to 10 minutes); it ends if you don Heavy armor or are Incapacitated.

features.name: Unarmored Defense
features.description: Without armor your base AC is 10 + Dex + Con; you can use a Shield.

features.name: Weapon Mastery
features.description: You can use the mastery properties of 2 kinds of Simple or Martial Melee weapons (more with levels, Weapon Mastery column); after a Long Rest you can change one.

features.name: Danger Sense
features.description: Advantage on Dexterity saving throws unless you have the Incapacitated condition.

features.name: Reckless Attack
features.description: On your first attack of the turn you can attack recklessly: Advantage on Strength-based attack rolls until the start of your next turn, but attack rolls against you have Advantage.

features.name: Barbarian Subclass
features.description: You gain a subclass of your choice; you gain its features at the levels shown.

features.name: Primal Knowledge
features.description: Proficiency in another skill from the Barbarian list. While raging you can make Acrobatics, Intimidation, Perception, Stealth, or Survival checks using Strength.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.description: You gain the Ability Score Improvement feat or another feat of your choice for which you qualify.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.description: You gain the Ability Score Improvement feat or another feat of your choice for which you qualify.

features.name: Extra Attack
features.description: You can attack twice when you take the Attack action.

features.name: Fast Movement
features.description: Your Speed increases by 10 feet while you aren't wearing Heavy armor.

features.name: Feral Instinct
features.description: Advantage on Initiative rolls.

features.name: Instinctive Pounce
features.description: As part of the Bonus Action to enter your Rage, you can move up to half your Speed.

features.name: Brutal Strike
features.description: If you use Reckless Attack you can forgo Advantage on one Strength-based attack: if it hits it deals 1d10 extra damage plus an effect: Forceful Blow (push the target 15 feet and move half your Speed toward it without Opportunity Attacks) or Hamstring Blow (target's Speed −15 feet until your next turn).

features.name: Relentless Rage
features.description: While raging, if you drop to 0 Hit Points without being killed outright, make a Constitution save (DC 10): on a success your Hit Points become twice your Barbarian level. The DC rises by 5 for each use after the first and resets to 10 after a Short or Long Rest.

features.name: Improved Brutal Strike
features.description: New Brutal Strike effects: Staggering Blow (target has Disadvantage on its next save and can't make Opportunity Attacks until your next turn) and Sundering Blow (+5 to the next attack roll against the target by another creature).

features.name: Persistent Rage
features.description: When you roll Initiative you regain all expended Rage uses (once per Long Rest). Your Rage lasts 10 minutes without extending it and ends early only if you are Unconscious or don Heavy armor.

features.name: Improved Brutal Strike
features.description: The extra damage of Brutal Strike rises to 2d10 and you can apply two different effects.

features.name: Indomitable Might
features.description: If your total for a Strength check or save is less than your Strength score, you can use the score instead.

features.name: Epic Boon
features.description: You gain an Epic Boon feat or another feat of your choice for which you qualify. Recommended: Boon of Irresistible Offense.

features.name: Primal Champion
features.description: Your Strength and Constitution scores increase by 4, to a maximum of 25.

entries.name: Bard
entries.description: A performer and spellcaster: Bardic Inspiration, Expertise, and spells from several class lists.

features.name: Bardic Inspiration
features.description: As a Bonus Action give a creature within 60 feet that can see or hear you a Bardic Inspiration die (Bardic Die column): within 1 hour, when it fails a D20 Test it can roll the die and add it. A creature holds one at a time. Uses equal your Charisma modifier (minimum 1) per Long Rest.

features.name: Spellcasting
features.description: You cast Bard spells using Charisma, with a musical instrument as a focus. You know 2 cantrips (more at levels 4 and 10) and prepare spells (Prepared Spells column) from the Bard list, of a level you have slots for; whenever you gain a Bard level you can swap one. Slots return after a Long Rest.

features.name: Expertise
features.description: Expertise in two skills you're proficient in (Performance and Persuasion are recommended). Two more at level 9.

features.name: Jack of All Trades
features.description: You add half your Proficiency Bonus (rounded down) to any ability check that doesn't already include it.

features.name: Bard Subclass
features.description: You gain a subclass of your choice; you gain its features at the levels shown.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.description: You gain the Ability Score Improvement feat or another feat of your choice for which you qualify.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.description: You gain the Ability Score Improvement feat or another feat of your choice for which you qualify.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.description: You gain the Ability Score Improvement feat or another feat of your choice for which you qualify.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.description: You gain the Ability Score Improvement feat or another feat of your choice for which you qualify.

features.name: Font of Inspiration
features.description: You regain all expended Bardic Inspiration uses after a Short or Long Rest; you can also expend a spell slot (no action) to regain one use.

features.name: Countercharm
features.description: As a Reaction, when you or a creature within 30 feet fails a save against an effect that applies Charmed or Frightened, the save is rerolled with Advantage.

features.name: Expertise
features.description: Expertise in two more skills you're proficient in.

features.name: Magical Secrets
features.description: When your number of prepared spells increases you can choose any spell from the Bard, Cleric, Druid, and Wizard lists: they count as Bard spells for you. You can swap a prepared spell for one from these lists.

features.name: Superior Inspiration
features.description: When you roll Initiative with fewer than two Bardic Inspiration uses, you regain uses until you have two.

features.name: Epic Boon
features.description: You gain an Epic Boon feat or another feat of your choice for which you qualify. Recommended: Boon of Spell Recall.

features.name: Words of Creation
features.description: Power Word Heal and Power Word Kill are always prepared; when you cast either you can target a second creature within 10 feet of the first.

entries.name: Cleric
entries.description: A divine spellcaster: Divine Order, Channel Divinity, and holy healing or offense.

features.name: Spellcasting
features.description: You cast Cleric spells using Wisdom, with a holy symbol as a focus. You know 3 cantrips (more at levels 4 and 10) and prepare spells (Prepared Spells column) from the Cleric list; after a Long Rest you can change the list. Slots return after a Long Rest.

features.name: Divine Order
features.description: Choose a sacred role: Protector (proficiency with Martial weapons and Heavy armor) or Thaumaturge (one extra cantrip and a bonus to Intelligence (Arcana or Religion) checks equal to your Wisdom modifier, minimum +1).

features.name: Channel Divinity
features.description: You channel divine energy with two effects: Divine Spark (Magic action: a creature within 30 feet regains 1d8 + Wis Hit Points, or takes Necrotic/Radiant damage with a Constitution save; more dice at 7, 13, 18) and Turn Undead (Wisdom save or Undead within 30 feet are Frightened and Incapacitated for 1 minute). Uses are in the Channel Divinity column: regain one on a Short Rest, all on a Long Rest.

features.name: Cleric Subclass
features.description: You gain a subclass of your choice; you gain its features at the levels shown.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.description: You gain the Ability Score Improvement feat or another feat of your choice for which you qualify.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.description: You gain the Ability Score Improvement feat or another feat of your choice for which you qualify.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.description: You gain the Ability Score Improvement feat or another feat of your choice for which you qualify.

features.name: Sear Undead
features.description: When you use Turn Undead, roll a number of d8s equal to your Wisdom modifier (minimum 1): Undead that fail the save take that Radiant damage.

features.name: Blessed Strikes
features.description: Choose: Divine Strike (once per turn, when you hit with a weapon, +1d8 Necrotic or Radiant damage) or Potent Spellcasting (add your Wisdom modifier to Cleric cantrip damage).

features.name: Divine Intervention
features.description: As a Magic action you cast any Cleric spell of level 5 or lower (that doesn't need a Reaction) without a slot or Material components. Once per Long Rest.

features.name: Improved Blessed Strikes
features.description: Divine Strike: +2d8. Potent Spellcasting: when a Cleric cantrip deals damage you can give yourself or a creature within 60 feet Temporary Hit Points equal to twice your Wisdom modifier.

features.name: Epic Boon
features.description: You gain an Epic Boon feat or another feat of your choice for which you qualify. Recommended: Boon of Fate.

features.name: Greater Divine Intervention
features.description: When you use Divine Intervention you can choose Wish; if you do, you can't use Divine Intervention again until you finish 2d4 Long Rests.

entries.name: Fighter
entries.description: A master of weapons and armor: more attacks, Second Wind, and extra actions.

features.name: Fighting Style
features.description: You gain a Fighting Style feat of your choice (Defense is recommended). Whenever you gain a Fighter level you can replace it with another.

features.name: Second Wind
features.description: As a Bonus Action you regain 1d10 + your Fighter level Hit Points. Uses are in the Second Wind column: regain one on a Short Rest, all on a Long Rest.

features.name: Weapon Mastery
features.description: You can use the mastery properties of 3 kinds of Simple or Martial weapons (more with levels, Weapon Mastery column); after a Long Rest you can change one.

features.name: Action Surge
features.description: On your turn you can take one additional action (except the Magic action). Once per Short or Long Rest; twice from level 17, but only once per turn.

features.name: Tactical Mind
features.description: When you fail an ability check you can expend a Second Wind use: roll 1d10 and add it to the check. If you still fail, the use isn't expended.

features.name: Fighter Subclass
features.description: You gain a subclass of your choice; you gain its features at the levels shown.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.description: You gain the Ability Score Improvement feat or another feat of your choice for which you qualify.

features.name: Extra Attack
features.description: You can attack twice when you take the Attack action.

features.name: Tactical Shift
features.description: Whenever you activate Second Wind you can move up to half your Speed without provoking Opportunity Attacks.

features.name: Indomitable
features.description: If you fail a saving throw you can reroll it with a bonus equal to your Fighter level; you must use the new roll. Once per Long Rest; twice from level 13, three times from level 17.

features.name: Tactical Master
features.description: When you attack with a weapon whose mastery you can use, you can replace its property with Push, Sap, or Slow.

features.name: Two Extra Attacks
features.description: You can attack three times when you take the Attack action.

features.name: Studied Attacks
features.description: If you miss a creature with an attack roll, you have Advantage on your next attack roll against it before the end of your next turn.

features.name: Epic Boon
features.description: You gain an Epic Boon feat or another feat of your choice for which you qualify. Recommended: Boon of Combat Prowess.

features.name: Three Extra Attacks
features.description: You can attack four times when you take the Attack action.

entries.name: Monk
entries.description: An agile martial artist: Unarmed Strikes, Focus Points, and extraordinary movement.

features.name: Martial Arts
features.description: While wearing no armor or Shield and using only Unarmed Strikes or Monk weapons (Simple Melee and Light Martial Melee weapons): a Bonus Action Unarmed Strike; a Martial Arts die instead of normal damage (Martial Arts column); you can use Dexterity instead of Strength for attack and damage rolls and for the grapple and shove save DC.

features.name: Unarmored Defense
features.description: Without armor or a Shield your base AC is 10 + Dex + Wis.

features.name: Monk's Focus
features.description: You gain Focus Points (Focus Points column) that return after a Short or Long Rest. You spend them on Flurry of Blows (two Unarmed Strikes as a Bonus Action), Patient Defense (Disengage and Dodge as a Bonus Action), and Step of the Wind (Disengage and Dash as a Bonus Action, doubled jump). Your save DC is 8 + Wis + Proficiency. Without spending points you can still Disengage or Dash as a Bonus Action.

features.name: Unarmored Movement
features.description: Your Speed increases by 10 feet while you aren't wearing armor or wielding a Shield; the bonus grows with levels (Unarmored Movement column).

features.name: Uncanny Metabolism
features.description: When you roll Initiative you regain all expended Focus Points and heal Hit Points equal to your Monk level + a roll of your Martial Arts die. Once per Long Rest.

features.name: Deflect Attacks
features.description: As a Reaction when an attack roll that includes Bludgeoning, Piercing, or Slashing damage hits you, reduce the damage by 1d10 + Dex + your Monk level. If reduced to 0 you can spend 1 Focus Point to redirect the force at a visible creature (within 5 feet for melee, 60 feet for ranged): Dexterity save or it takes two rolls of your Martial Arts die + Dex.

features.name: Monk Subclass
features.description: You gain a subclass of your choice; you gain its features at the levels shown.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.description: You gain the Ability Score Improvement feat or another feat of your choice for which you qualify.

features.name: Slow Fall
features.description: As a Reaction when you fall, reduce the falling damage by five times your Monk level.

features.name: Extra Attack
features.description: You can attack twice when you take the Attack action.

features.name: Stunning Strike
features.description: Once per turn when you hit with a Monk weapon or Unarmed Strike you can spend 1 Focus Point: Constitution save; on a failure the target is Stunned until the start of your next turn; on a success its Speed is halved and the next attack roll against it has Advantage.

features.name: Empowered Strikes
features.description: Your Unarmed Strikes can deal Force damage instead of their normal type.

features.name: Evasion
features.description: When an effect lets you make a Dexterity save to take half damage, you take none on a success and half on a failure (not if Incapacitated).

features.name: Acrobatic Movement
features.description: While not wearing armor or wielding a Shield you can move along vertical surfaces and across liquids on your turn without falling.

features.name: Heightened Focus
features.description: Flurry of Blows makes three strikes; Patient Defense grants Temporary Hit Points equal to two Martial Arts rolls; Step of the Wind lets you carry a willing Large or smaller creature within 5 feet along.

features.name: Self-Restoration
features.description: At the end of each of your turns you can remove the Charmed, Frightened, or Poisoned condition from yourself; forgoing food and drink doesn't give you Exhaustion levels.

features.name: Deflect Energy
features.description: Deflect Attacks works against attacks that deal any damage type.

features.name: Disciplined Survivor
features.description: Proficiency in all saving throws. When you fail a saving throw you can spend 1 Focus Point to reroll it (you must use the new roll).

features.name: Perfect Focus
features.description: When you roll Initiative and don't use Uncanny Metabolism, you regain Focus Points until you have 4 (if you have 3 or fewer).

features.name: Superior Defense
features.description: At the start of your turn you can spend 3 Focus Points: for 1 minute (or until Incapacitated) you have Resistance to all damage except Force.

features.name: Epic Boon
features.description: You gain an Epic Boon feat or another feat of your choice for which you qualify. Recommended: Boon of Irresistible Offense.

features.name: Body and Mind
features.description: Your Dexterity and Wisdom scores increase by 4, to a maximum of 25.

entries.name: Paladin
entries.description: A sworn holy warrior: Lay On Hands, Divine Smite, Channel Divinity, and protective auras.

features.name: Lay On Hands
features.description: You have a pool of healing equal to five times your Paladin level (restored on a Long Rest). As a Bonus Action touch a creature and restore Hit Points from the pool; spend 5 points to remove the Poisoned condition (no Hit Points restored).

features.name: Spellcasting
features.description: You cast Paladin spells using Charisma, with a holy symbol as a focus. You prepare spells (Prepared Spells column) from the Paladin list, of a level you have slots for; after a Long Rest you can swap one. Slots return after a Long Rest.

features.name: Weapon Mastery
features.description: You can use the mastery properties of 2 kinds of weapons you're proficient with; after a Long Rest you can change one.

features.name: Fighting Style
features.description: You gain a Fighting Style feat of your choice, or Blessed Warrior: you learn two Cleric cantrips (they count as Paladin spells, using Charisma) and can swap one whenever you gain a Paladin level.

features.name: Paladin's Smite
features.description: Divine Smite is always prepared and you can cast it once without a slot per Long Rest.

features.name: Channel Divinity
features.description: You channel divine energy; you start with Divine Sense (Bonus Action: for 10 minutes you know the location and type of Celestials, Fiends, and Undead within 60 feet, and of hallowed or desecrated places). Uses are in the Channel Divinity column: one on a Short Rest, all on a Long Rest.

features.name: Paladin Subclass
features.description: You gain a subclass of your choice; you gain its features at the levels shown.

features.description: You gain the Ability Score Improvement feat or another feat of your choice for which you qualify.

features.name: Extra Attack
features.description: You can attack twice when you take the Attack action.

features.name: Faithful Steed
features.description: Find Steed is always prepared and you can cast it once without a slot per Long Rest.

features.name: Aura of Protection
features.description: 10-foot Emanation (inactive if you're Incapacitated): you and your allies gain a bonus to saving throws equal to your Charisma modifier (minimum +1). A creature gets only one such bonus.

features.name: Abjure Foes
features.description: Magic action, expending a Channel Divinity use: up to Charisma modifier creatures (minimum 1) within 60 feet make a Wisdom save or are Frightened for 1 minute (or until damaged) and can take only a move, an action, or a Bonus Action on their turn.

features.name: Aura of Courage
features.description: You and your allies have Immunity to the Frightened condition while in your Aura of Protection; a Frightened ally that enters it has the condition suspended while inside.

features.name: Radiant Strikes
features.description: When you hit with a Melee weapon or Unarmed Strike, the target takes an extra 1d8 Radiant damage.

features.name: Restoring Touch
features.description: When you use Lay On Hands you can also remove Blinded, Charmed, Deafened, Paralyzed, Frightened, or Stunned, spending 5 points from the pool per condition.

features.name: Aura Expansion
features.description: Your Aura of Protection becomes a 30-foot Emanation.

features.name: Epic Boon
features.description: You gain an Epic Boon feat or another feat of your choice for which you qualify. Recommended: Boon of Truesight.

entries.name: Ranger
entries.description: A wilderness hunter and scout: Hunter's Mark, nature magic, and survival skills.

features.name: Spellcasting
features.description: You cast Ranger spells using Wisdom, with a Druidic Focus. You prepare spells (Prepared Spells column) from the Ranger list, of a level you have slots for; after a Long Rest you can swap one. Slots return after a Long Rest.

features.name: Favored Enemy
features.description: Hunter's Mark is always prepared and you can cast it without a slot the number of times shown in the Favored Enemy column, per Long Rest.

features.name: Weapon Mastery
features.description: You can use the mastery properties of 2 kinds of weapons you're proficient with; after a Long Rest you can change one.

features.name: Deft Explorer
features.description: Expertise in one skill you're proficient in, and two languages of your choice.

features.name: Fighting Style
features.description: You gain a Fighting Style feat of your choice, or Druidic Warrior: you learn two Druid cantrips (they count as Ranger spells, using Wisdom) and can swap one whenever you gain a Ranger level.

features.name: Ranger Subclass
features.description: You gain a subclass of your choice; you gain its features at the levels shown.

features.description: You can attack twice when you take the Attack action.

features.name: Roving
features.description: Your Speed increases by 10 feet while you aren't wearing Heavy armor; you have Climb and Swim Speeds equal to your Speed.

features.name: Expertise
features.description: Expertise in two more skills you're proficient in.

features.name: Tireless
features.description: Magic action: gain 1d8 + Wisdom Temporary Hit Points (minimum 1), uses equal Wisdom (minimum 1) per Long Rest. A Short Rest reduces your Exhaustion level by 1.

features.name: Relentless Hunter
features.description: Taking damage can't break your Concentration on Hunter's Mark.

features.name: Nature's Veil
features.description: Bonus Action: you become Invisible until the end of your next turn. Uses equal Wisdom (minimum 1) per Long Rest.

features.name: Precise Hunter
features.description: You have Advantage on attack rolls against the creature marked by your Hunter's Mark.

features.name: Feral Senses
features.description: You have Blindsight with a range of 30 feet.

features.name: Epic Boon
features.description: You gain an Epic Boon feat or another feat of your choice for which you qualify. Recommended: Boon of Dimensional Travel.

features.name: Foe Slayer
features.description: The damage of Hunter's Mark uses a d10 instead of a d6.

entries.name: Rogue
entries.description: A specialist in stealth and precision: Sneak Attack, Expertise, and uncanny dodges.

features.name: Expertise
features.description: Expertise in two skills you're proficient in (Sleight of Hand and Stealth are recommended). Two more at level 6.

features.name: Sneak Attack
features.description: Once per turn you deal extra damage (Sneak Attack column) to a creature you hit with a Finesse or Ranged weapon if you have Advantage, or if a non-Incapacitated ally is within 5 feet of the target (and you don't have Disadvantage). The extra damage has the weapon's type.

features.name: Thieves' Cant
features.description: You know Thieves' Cant and one other language of your choice.

features.name: Weapon Mastery
features.description: You can use the mastery properties of 2 kinds of weapons you're proficient with (such as Daggers and Shortbows); after a Long Rest you can change one.

features.name: Cunning Action
features.description: On your turn you can take Dash, Disengage, or Hide as a Bonus Action.

features.name: Rogue Subclass
features.description: You gain a subclass of your choice; you gain its features at the levels shown.

features.name: Steady Aim
features.description: As a Bonus Action you gain Advantage on your next attack roll this turn; only if you haven't moved this turn, and your Speed becomes 0 until the end of the turn.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.description: You gain the Ability Score Improvement feat or another feat of your choice for which you qualify.

features.name: Cunning Strike
features.description: When you deal Sneak Attack damage you can forgo dice to add an effect: Trip (1d6: Dexterity save or Prone, if Large or smaller), Withdraw (1d6: move up to half your Speed without Opportunity Attacks), Poison (1d6: Constitution save or Poisoned for 1 minute; requires a Poisoner's Kit). DC 8 + Dex + Proficiency.

features.name: Uncanny Dodge
features.description: As a Reaction when an attacker you can see hits you, you halve the attack's damage (rounded down).

features.name: Expertise
features.description: Expertise in two more skills you're proficient in.

features.name: Evasion
features.description: When an effect lets you make a Dexterity save to take half damage, you take none on a success and half on a failure (not if Incapacitated).

features.name: Reliable Talent
features.description: When you make an ability check with a skill or tool you're proficient with, a d20 roll of 9 or lower counts as a 10.

features.name: Improved Cunning Strike
features.description: You can use up to two Cunning Strike effects, paying the dice cost of each.

features.name: Devious Strikes
features.description: New Cunning Strike options: Knock Out (6d6: Constitution save or Unconscious), Obscure (3d6: Dexterity save or Blinded), Daze (2d6: Constitution save or limited to a move, action, or Bonus Action on its next turn).

features.name: Slippery Mind
features.description: Proficiency in Wisdom and Charisma saving throws.

features.name: Elusive
features.description: No attack roll has Advantage against you unless you have the Incapacitated condition.

features.name: Epic Boon
features.description: You gain an Epic Boon feat or another feat of your choice for which you qualify. Recommended: Boon of the Night Spirit.

features.name: Stroke of Luck
features.description: If you fail a D20 Test you can turn the roll into a 20. Once per Short or Long Rest.
